How to use La Case des Savoirs

For readers looking for practical books on community development, eco-tourism, farming, A-frame building and African innovation, and for authors who want to publish chapter by chapter.

Open La Case des Savoirs ↗Platform detailsContact

Guided tourReal screens

Plays automatically. Use the dots or arrows to move, Pause to stop.

01

Getting started

1

Go to terra-village-reads.lovable.app and click Explorer les livres.

2

Search by title, chapter or subject.

3

Open a book; your place is saved.

4

Create an account to bookmark, highlight and take notes.

5

Subscribe to open the full catalogue.

02

Features

01

Library

Featured books and the full catalogue by subject, with search across all chapters.

STEPS

  1. Browse by subject
  2. Search a term
  3. Add a book to your shelf
02

Reader

Reading modes, bookmarks, highlights and notes. Progress follows your account.

STEPS

  1. Choose a reading mode
  2. Highlight a passage and add a note
  3. Resume where you stopped
03

Subscription

One subscription opens the full catalogue. Featured books are free.

STEPS

  1. Open Abonnement
  2. Choose a plan and pay
  3. Read any book
04

Submit a project

Authors and communities can propose a book or a manual. Chapters are published from the admin dashboard.

STEPS

  1. Click Soumettre un projet
  2. Describe the book
  3. Send the chapters
03Tips
  • Books load chapter by chapter, which helps on slow connections.
  • Notes and highlights are saved to your account.
  • French first; English is one click away.
04FAQ
Is it free?

Featured books are free. The full catalogue requires a subscription.

Can I read offline?

No. It is a web app and needs a connection.

Who publishes?

Authors and communities, through the submission form.

Which languages?

French and English.
